objective: Speak with Orm Stonehoof in Thunder Bluff.

description: Orm Stonehoof is respected greatly for his skill.  He will make for you the brutal helm.
Seek him out in Thunder Bluff, near the pool by the city's great, central totem.
completion: Greetings, warrior.  I am Orm, and Thun'grim tells me you wish a helm made?
